articles.title: From Complacency to Contenders: How Pochettino’s ‘Ant Work’ Transformed the USMNT
articles.summary: Coach Mauricio Pochettino overhauled the U.S. men’s soccer team by trying out over 70 players and benching complacent regulars. After early losses, the squad won their 2026 World Cup group and now face Bosnia in the knockout round. His philosophy: slow, relentless progress.

articles.title: Framework Deal with Lebanon Divides Israel as Hezbollah Rejects Terms
articles.summary: A U.S.-brokered framework signed by Israel and Lebanon aims to disarm Hezbollah before Israeli troops withdraw from southern Lebanon. Hezbollah immediately rejected it, calling it ‘null and void.’ Over 4,000 have died since March. Israeli politicians are split, with cautious optimism from northern leaders.
